_note: Real Google reviews for Fat Fish. Only entries with rating >= 4 are shown. NOTE: star ratings were assumed to be 5 from the review wording — update any that differ. Relative dates are frozen in time here; with the live Google Places API they would self-update.

reviews.name: Luis Quintero
reviews.text: Excellent service and very good communication with the customer from the staff. I will definitely return and recommend this place to my friends and acquaintances.

reviews.name: Victoria Hernandez
reviews.text: The soups were delicious, and the sushi was yum! The staff was very friendly and they speak Spanish. I'll definitely be back soon.

reviews.name: Aracely Garcia
reviews.text: I love it, everything is delicious, I highly recommend it, and I especially love the soybeans.

reviews.name: Michelle
reviews.text: Came here for my last meal in the country for a while, and it couldn’t have been a better choice.
